40: // Deploy converges the lab to the requested topology. A lab without runtime state is
41: // deployed from scratch, an already deployed lab is reconciled in place.

43: 	ctx context.Context,
44: 	options *DeployOptions,
45: ) (*DeployResult, error) {
46: 	if options == nil {

61:

64: 			return nil, err
65: 		}

68: 	}
69: 
70: 	if c.LabRuntime != nil && options.dryRun {
71: 		planner, ok := c.LabRuntime.(clablabruntime.TopologyPlanner)
72: 		if !ok {
73: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("lab runtime %q does not support dry-run", c.globalRuntimeName)
74: 		}
75: 
76: 		req, err := c.labRuntimeDeployRequest()
77: 		if err != nil {
78: 			return nil, err
79: 		}
80: 		applyLabRuntimeDeployOptions(&req, options)
81: 
82: 		plan, err := planner.Plan(ctx, req)
83: 		if err != nil {
84: 			return nil, err
85: 		}
86: 
87: 		return &DeployResult{RuntimePlan: plan}, nil
88: 	}
89:

93: 	}

97: 	}

101: 				Apply: &ApplyResult{

182: 	options *DeployOptions,

185: 		return c.deployWithLabRuntime(ctx, options)

189: 
190: 	err = c.ResolveLinks()

192: 		return nil, err

196:

199: 		log.Info("Removing directory", "path", c.TopoPaths.TopologyLabDir())

211: 	if err := c.checkTopologyDefinition(ctx); err != nil {

213: 	}
214: 
215: 	if err := c.prepareDeployArtifacts(ctx, options.skipLabDirFileACLs); err != nil {
216: 		return nil, err
217: 	}
218: 
219: 	// Apply snapshot restore configuration to nodes
220: 	if err := c.configureSnapshotRestore(options); err != nil {
221: 		return nil, err
222: 	}
223: 
224: 	nodesWg, execCollection, nodeFailCh, err := c.createNodes(
225: 		ctx,
226: 		options.maxWorkers,
227: 		options.skipPostDeploy,
228: 	)
229: 	if err != nil {
230: 		return nil, err
231: 	}
232: 
233: 	if err := waitForNodeDeploy(ctx, nodesWg, nodeFailCh); err != nil {
234: 		return nil, err
235: 	}
236: 	if err := c.syncTailscaleProxy(ctx); err != nil {
237: 		return nil, err
238: 	}
239: 	if err := c.SyncMgmtHostRoutes(ctx); err != nil {
240: 		return nil, err
241: 	}
242: 
243: 	// also call deploy on the special nodes endpoints (only host is required for the
244: 	// vxlan stitched endpoints).
245: 	// this must happen after all node workers have finished so that veth pairs created
246: 	// as part of vxlan-stitch links are already deployed before the stitch TC rules are applied.
247: 	eps := c.getSpecialLinkNodes()["host"].GetEndpoints()
248: 	for _, ep := range eps {
249: 		err = ep.Deploy(ctx)
250: 		if err != nil {
251: 			log.Warnf("failed deploying endpoint %s", ep)
252: 		}
253: 	}
254: 
255: 	// Stitch links after node workers and host endpoints have finished.
256: 	// The veth pair is already created by node workers and the VxLAN interface is created
257: 	// by host endpoint deploy; Stitch applies the TC redirect rules to bridge them.
258: 	var linkPostDeployWorkers errgroup.Group
259: 	linkPostDeployWorkers.SetLimit(int(options.maxWorkers))
260: 	for _, link := range c.Links {
261: 		linkPostDeployWorkers.Go(func() error {
262: 			if err := link.PostDeploy(ctx); err != nil {
263: 				log.Warnf("failed post-deploying link: %v", err)
264: 			}
265: 			return nil
266: 		})
267: 	}
268: 	_ = linkPostDeployWorkers.Wait()
269: 
270: 	if err := applyLinkImpairments(ctx, linksEndpoints(c.Links)); err != nil {
271: 		return nil, err
272: 	}
273: 
274: 	execCollection.Log()
275: 
276: 	return c.finalize(ctx, options.exportTemplate, options.graph)
277: }

279: func waitForNodeDeploy(
280: 	ctx context.Context,
281: 	nodesWg *sync.WaitGroup,
282: 	nodeFailCh chan error,
283: ) error {
284: 	if nodesWg != nil {
285: 		nodesWg.Wait()
286: 	}
287: 
288: 	close(nodeFailCh)
289: 
290: 	// Cancellation takes precedence over errors caused by workers unwinding, and
291: 	// prevents post-deploy work from running against a partial lab.
292: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
293: 		return err
294: 	}
295: 
296: 	var nodeFailErrs []error
297: 	for nodeErr := range nodeFailCh {
298: 		nodeFailErrs = append(nodeFailErrs, nodeErr)
299: 	}
300: 	if len(nodeFailErrs) > 0 {
301: 		return fmt.Errorf(
302: 			"deployment failed for one or more nodes: %w",
303: 			errors.Join(nodeFailErrs...),
304: 		)
305: 	}
306: 
307: 	return nil
308: }

327: func (c *CLab) allocateLabManagementIPs(
328: 	ctx context.Context,
329: 	existing []clabtypes.ExistingAddress,
330: ) error {
331: 	preferred := make(map[string]clabtypes.NodeAddresses)
332: 	state, err := c.LoadState()
333: 	if err != nil {
334: 		log.Warn("Ignoring preferred management addresses", "error", err)
335: 	}
336: 
337: 	if state != nil {
338: 		for name, addresses := range state.IPAM {
339: 			preferred[name] = addresses
340: 		}
341: 	}
342: 
343: 	for _, m := range c.allMgmtNetworks() {
344: 		if c.skipMgmtNetwork(m) {
345: 			continue
346: 		}
347: 		nodes := c.mgmtNetNodes(m)
348: 		if m.IPAM.Provider == clabtypes.IPAMProviderRuntime || len(nodes) == 0 {
349: 			continue
350: 		}
351: 
352: 		reserved, err := c.collectReservedManagementAddresses(ctx, m, existing)
353: 		if err != nil {
354: 			return err
355: 		}
356: 
357: 		err = mgmt.AllocateManagementIPs(
358: 			ctx,
359: 			m,
360: 			nodes,
361: 			clabtypes.AllocationOptions{
362: 				Existing:  existing,
363: 				Preferred: preferred,
364: 				Reserved:  reserved,
365: 			},
366: 		)
367: 		if err != nil {
368: 			return err
369: 		}
370: 	}
371: 
372: 	return nil
373: }

375: func (c *CLab) collectReservedManagementAddresses(
376: 	ctx context.Context,
377: 	m *clabtypes.MgmtNet,
378: 	existing []clabtypes.ExistingAddress,
379: ) ([]netip.Addr, error) {
380: 	var subnets []netip.Prefix
381: 	for _, value := range []string{m.IPv4Subnet, m.IPv6Subnet} {
382: 		if value == "" {
383: 			continue
384: 		}
385: 		subnet, err := netip.ParsePrefix(value)
386: 		if err != nil {
387: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("management subnet %q: %w", value, err)
388: 		}
389: 		subnets = append(subnets, subnet)
390: 	}
391: 	occupied, err := c.globalRuntime().NetworkAddresses(ctx, subnets)
392: 	if err != nil {
393: 		return nil, err
394: 	}
395: 	type ownerAddress struct {
396: 		containerID string
397: 		address     netip.Addr
398: 	}
399: 	reused := make(map[ownerAddress]bool, len(existing))
400: 	for _, entry := range existing {
401: 		if entry.ContainerID != "" {
402: 			reused[ownerAddress{entry.ContainerID, entry.Address}] = true
403: 		}
404: 	}
405: 
406: 	var reserved []netip.Addr
407: 	for _, entry := range occupied {
408: 		if entry.NetworkName == m.Network &&
409: 			reused[ownerAddress{entry.ContainerID, entry.Address}] {
410: 			continue
411: 		}
412: 		reserved = append(reserved, entry.Address)
413: 	}
414: 	return reserved, nil
415: }

519: // certificateAuthoritySetup sets up the certificate authority parameters.
520: func (c *CLab) certificateAuthoritySetup() error {
521: 	// init the Cert storage and CA
522: 	c.Cert.CertStorage = clabcert.NewLocalDirCertStorage(c.TopoPaths)
523: 	c.Cert.CA = clabcert.NewCA()
524: 
525: 	s := c.Config.Settings
526: 
527: 	// Set defaults for the CA parameters
528: 	keySize := 2048
529: 	validityDuration := time.Until(time.Now().AddDate(1, 0, 0)) // 1 year as default
530: 	var extCACert, extCAKey string
531: 
532: 	// check that Settings.CertificateAuthority exists.
533: 	if s != nil && s.CertificateAuthority != nil {
534: 		// if ValidityDuration is set use the value
535: 		if s.CertificateAuthority.ValidityDuration != 0 {
536: 			validityDuration = s.CertificateAuthority.ValidityDuration
537: 		}
538: 
539: 		// if KeyLength is set use the value
540: 		if s.CertificateAuthority.KeySize != 0 {
541: 			keySize = s.CertificateAuthority.KeySize
542: 		}
543: 
544: 		// if external CA cert and key are set, propagate to topopaths
545: 		extCACert = s.CertificateAuthority.Cert
546: 		extCAKey = s.CertificateAuthority.Key
547: 	}
548: 
549: 	// override external ca and key from env vars

562: 		}
563: 	}

565: 	// define the attributes used to generate the CA Cert
566: 	caCertInput := &clabcert.CACSRInput{

568: 		Country:      "US",

577: // createNodes schedules nodes creation and returns a waitgroup for all nodes
578: // with the exec collection created from the exec config of each node.
579: // The exec collection is returned to the caller to ensure that the execution log
580: // is printed after the nodes are created.
581: // Nodes interdependencies are created in this function.
582: func (c *CLab) createNodes(
583: 	ctx context.Context,
584: 	maxWorkers uint,
585: 	skipPostDeploy bool,
586: ) (*sync.WaitGroup, *clabexec.ExecCollection, chan error, error) {
587: 	for _, node := range c.Nodes {
588: 		c.dependencyManager.AddNode(node)
589: 	}
590: 
591: 	// nodes with static mgmt IP should be scheduled before the dynamic ones
592: 	err := c.createStaticDynamicDependency()
593: 	if err != nil {
594: 		return nil, nil, nil, err
595: 	}
596: 
597: 	// create user-defined node dependencies done with `wait-for` property of the deployment stage
598: 	err = c.createWaitForDependency()
599: 	if err != nil {
600: 		return nil, nil, nil, err
601: 	}
602: 
603: 	// make network namespace shared containers start in the right order
604: 	c.createNamespaceSharingDependency()
605: 
606: 	// Add possible additional dependencies here
607: 
608: 	// make sure that there are no unresolvable dependencies, which would deadlock.
609: 	err = c.dependencyManager.CheckAcyclicity()
610: 	if err != nil {
611: 		return nil, nil, nil, err
612: 	}
613: 
614: 	// Buffered so workers never block reporting a failure (at most one failure path per node).
615: 	// With zero nodes, nothing sends on this channel; an empty buffer is fine.
616: 	nodeFailCh := make(chan error, len(c.Nodes))
617: 
618: 	// start scheduling
619: 	NodesWg, execCollection := c.scheduleNodes(ctx, int(maxWorkers), skipPostDeploy, nodeFailCh)
620: 
621: 	return NodesWg, execCollection, nodeFailCh, nil
622: }

633: // deployApplyNodes schedules starts and creates together: a new sidecar can
634: // depend on a stopped target, and a stopped node can depend on a new target.
635: func (c *CLab) deployApplyNodes(ctx context.Context, plan *applyPlan, maxWorkers uint) error {
636: 	nodeNames := sortedStringSet(
637: 		unionStringSets(plan.addedNodeSet, plan.recreatedNodeSet, plan.startNodeSet),
638: 	)
639: 	return c.deployNodes(ctx, nodeNames, maxWorkers, plan.startNodeSet)
640: }

642: func (c *CLab) deployNodes(
643: 	ctx context.Context,
644: 	nodeNames []string,
645: 	maxWorkers uint,
646: 	startNodeSet map[string]struct{},
647: ) error {
648: 	if len(nodeNames) == 0 {
649: 		return nil
650: 	}
651: 
652: 	if maxWorkers == 0 || int(maxWorkers) > len(nodeNames) {
653: 		maxWorkers = uint(len(nodeNames))
654: 	}
655: 	if _, err := c.networkModeNodeOrder(nodeNames); err != nil {
656: 		return err
657: 	}
658: 
659: 	input := make(chan string)
660: 	errCh := make(chan error, len(nodeNames))
661: 	completed := make(map[string]*nodeDeployCompletion, len(nodeNames))
662: 	for _, name := range nodeNames {
663: 		completed[name] = &nodeDeployCompletion{done: make(chan struct{})}
664: 	}
665: 	finish := func(name string, err error) {
666: 		completed[name].err = err
667: 		close(completed[name].done)
668: 		errCh <- err
669: 	}
670: 
671: 	for range maxWorkers {
672: 		go func() {
673: 			for nodeName := range input {
674: 				if _, start := startNodeSet[nodeName]; start {
675: 					log.Info("Starting stopped node", "node", nodeName)
676: 					err := c.Nodes[nodeName].Start(ctx)
677: 					if err != nil {
678: 						err = fmt.Errorf("failed starting node %q: %w", nodeName, err)
679: 					}
680: 					finish(nodeName, err)
681: 					continue
682: 				}
683: 				log.Info("Creating node", "node", nodeName)
684: 				finish(nodeName, c.deployNode(ctx, c.Nodes[nodeName]))
685: 			}
686: 		}()
687: 	}
688: 
689: 	// Wait outside the worker pool. Targets in this operation signal completion
690: 	// directly, avoiding runtime polling and propagating failures to dependents.
691: 	var feedWg sync.WaitGroup
692: 	for _, nodeName := range nodeNames {
693: 		feedWg.Add(1)
694: 		go func(nodeName string) {
695: 			defer feedWg.Done()
696: 			if err := c.waitForNodeDeployTarget(ctx, nodeName, completed); err != nil {
697: 				finish(nodeName, err)
698: 				return
699: 			}
700: 			select {
701: 			case input <- nodeName:
702: 			case <-ctx.Done():
703: 				finish(nodeName, ctx.Err())
704: 			}
705: 		}(nodeName)
706: 	}
707: 	go func() {
708: 		feedWg.Wait()
709: 		close(input)
710: 	}()
711: 
712: 	var errs []error
713: 	for range nodeNames {
714: 		if err := <-errCh; err != nil {
715: 			errs = append(errs, err)
716: 		}
717: 	}
718: 
719: 	if len(errs) > 0 {
720: 		return errors.Join(errs...)
721: 	}
722: 
723: 	return nil
724: }
725: 
726: type nodeDeployCompletion struct {
727: 	done chan struct{}
728: 	// Closing done publishes err to dependent goroutines.
729: 	err error
730: }
731: 
732: func (c *CLab) waitForNodeDeployTarget(
733: 	ctx context.Context,
734: 	name string,
735: 	completed map[string]*nodeDeployCompletion,
736: ) error {
737: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
738: 		return err
739: 	}
740: 	target := networkModeContainerTarget(c.Nodes[name].Config().NetworkMode)
741: 	if target == "" {
742: 		target = c.Nodes[name].Config().Labels[clabnodestailscale.ParentLabel]
743: 	}
744: 	if completion, selected := completed[target]; selected {
745: 		select {
746: 		case <-completion.done:
747: 			if completion.err != nil {
748: 				return fmt.Errorf(
749: 					"node %q depends on failed node %q: %w",
750: 					name,
751: 					target,
752: 					completion.err,
753: 				)
754: 			}
755: 			return nil
756: 		case <-ctx.Done():
757: 			return ctx.Err()
758: 		}
759: 	}
760: 	return c.waitForApplyNetworkModeTarget(ctx, name)
761: }
762: 
763: // waitForApplyNetworkModeTarget waits until a node's network-mode:
764: // container:<target> target is running, so apply's incremental deploy never
765: // races a newly created or recreated target against its dependent. The
766: // target may be a node in this same apply call (added or recreated
767: // alongside the dependent) or, like fresh deploy, an external container not
768: // managed by this topology.
769: func (c *CLab) waitForApplyNetworkModeTarget(ctx context.Context, nodeName string) error {
770: 	node, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]
771: 	if !exists {
772: 		return nil
773: 	}
774: 
775: 	target := networkModeContainerTarget(node.Config().NetworkMode)
776: 	if target == "" {
777: 		return nil
778: 	}
779: 
780: 	targetNode, internal := c.Nodes[target]
781: 	if !internal {
782: 		return c.waitForExternalNodeDependencies(ctx, nodeName)
783: 	}
784: 
785: 	runtime := c.globalRuntime()
786: 	if runtime == nil {
787: 		return fmt.Errorf("container runtime is not initialized")
788: 	}
789: 
790: 	return clabruntime.WaitForContainerRunning(ctx, runtime, targetNode.Config().LongName, nodeName)
791: }

793: func (c *CLab) deployNode(ctx context.Context, node clabnodes.Node) error {
794: 	nodeName := node.GetShortName()

796: 		Cert:         c.Cert,
797: 		TopologyName: c.Config.Name,
798: 		TopoPaths:    c.TopoPaths,
799: 		SSHPubKeys:   c.SSHPubKeys,
800: 	}); err != nil {
801: 		return fmt.Errorf("node %q pre-deploy: %w", nodeName, err)
802: 	}
803: 
804: 	if err := node.Deploy(ctx, &clabnodes.DeployParams{Nodes: c.Nodes}); err != nil {
805: 		return fmt.Errorf("node %q deploy: %w", nodeName, err)
806: 	}
807: 
808: 	if err := node.UpdateConfigWithRuntimeInfo(ctx); err != nil {
809: 		log.Errorf("failed to update node runtime information for node %s: %v", nodeName, err)
810: 	}
811: 
812: 	return nil
813: }

820: func (c *CLab) deployLinks(
821: 	ctx context.Context,
822: 	links []clablinks.Link,
823: 	additionalNodeNames []string,
824: ) error {
825: 	touchedNodes := make(map[string]struct{}, len(additionalNodeNames))
826: 	for _, nodeName := range additionalNodeNames {
827: 		touchedNodes[nodeName] = struct{}{}
828: 	}
829: 	for _, link := range links {
830: 		log.Info("Creating link", "link", applyLinkName(link))
831: 
832: 		for _, ep := range clablinks.RuntimeEndpoints(link) {
833: 			if err := ep.Deploy(ctx); err != nil {
834: 				return fmt.Errorf("failed deploying link %s: %w", applyLinkName(link), err)
835: 			}
836: 			touchedNodes[ep.GetNode().GetShortName()] = struct{}{}
837: 		}
838: 
839: 		if err := link.PostDeploy(ctx); err != nil {
840: 			return fmt.Errorf("failed post-deploying link %s: %w", applyLinkName(link), err)
841: 		}
842: 	}
843: 
844: 	for _, nodeName := range sortedStringSet(touchedNodes) {
845: 		node, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]
846: 		if !exists {
847: 			continue
848: 		}
849: 		if err := node.PostDeployEndpoints(ctx); err != nil {
850: 			return fmt.Errorf("node %q post-deploy links: %w", nodeName, err)
851: 		}
852: 	}
853: 
854: 	return nil
855: }

939: // configureSnapshotRestore configures nodes for snapshot restoration.
940: // It resolves snapshot files for each node and adds the necessary volume mounts
941: // and environment variables to restore from snapshots.
942: func (c *CLab) configureSnapshotRestore(options *DeployOptions) error {
943: 	// Build restore map from per-node specifications
944: 	restoreMap := make(map[string]string)
945: 	for _, mapping := range options.restoreNodeSnapshots {
946: 		parts := strings.SplitN(mapping, "=", 2)
947: 		if len(parts) != 2 {
948: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid restore format: %s (expected: node=path)", mapping)
949: 		}
950: 		restoreMap[parts[0]] = parts[1]
951: 	}
952: 
953: 	// Track statistics for logging
954: 	var restoredCount, freshCount int
955: 
956: 	// Configure each node
957: 	for _, node := range c.Nodes {
958: 		nodeName := node.Config().ShortName
959: 
960: 		// Resolve snapshot path for this node
961: 		snapshotPath, shouldRestore := resolveNodeSnapshot(nodeName, restoreMap, options.restoreAll)
962: 
963: 		if shouldRestore {
964: 			// Validate snapshot file exists
965: 			if _, err := os.Stat(snapshotPath); os.IsNotExist(err) {
966: 				return fmt.Errorf("snapshot file not found for node %s: %s", nodeName, snapshotPath)
967: 			}
968: 
969: 			// Get absolute path for bind mount
970: 			absPath, err := filepath.Abs(snapshotPath)
971: 			if err != nil {
972: 				return fmt.Errorf("failed to get absolute path for %s: %w", snapshotPath, err)
973: 			}
974: 
975: 			// Add volume mount for snapshot (read-only)
976: 			node.Config().Binds = append(node.Config().Binds,
977: 				fmt.Sprintf("%s:/snapshot.tar:ro", absPath))
978: 
979: 			// Add restore environment variable
980: 			if node.Config().Env == nil {
981: 				node.Config().Env = make(map[string]string)
982: 			}
983: 			node.Config().Env["RESTORE_SNAPSHOT"] = "1"
984: 
985: 			log.Infof("Node %s will restore from: %s", nodeName, snapshotPath)
986: 			restoredCount++
987: 		} else {
988: 			freshCount++
989: 		}
990: 	}
991: 
992: 	// Log deployment mode summary if any restores are configured
993: 	if restoredCount > 0 {
994: 		log.Infof("Deploying %d nodes from snapshots, %d nodes fresh", restoredCount, freshCount)
995: 	}
996: 
997: 	return nil
998: }
999: 
1000: // resolveNodeSnapshot determines the snapshot file path for a given node.
1001: // Priority: per-node override > restore-all directory > none.
1002: func resolveNodeSnapshot(
1003: 	nodeName string,
1004: 	restoreMap map[string]string,
1005: 	restoreAll string,
1006: ) (string, bool) {
1007: 	// 1. Check per-node overrides first (highest priority)
1008: 	if snapshotPath, ok := restoreMap[nodeName]; ok {
1009: 		return snapshotPath, true
1010: 	}
1011: 
1012: 	// 2. Check restore-all directory
1013: 	if restoreAll != "" {
1014: 		// Look for {nodename}.tar in directory
1015: 		snapshotPath := filepath.Join(restoreAll, nodeName+".tar")
1016: 		if _, err := os.Stat(snapshotPath); err == nil {
1017: 			return snapshotPath, true
1018: 		}
1019: 
1020: 		// Not found - this is OK, just deploy normally
1021: 		log.Debugf("No snapshot found for node %s in %s, deploying normally", nodeName, restoreAll)
1022: 		return "", false
1023: 	}
1024: 
1025: 	// 3. No restore specified
1026: 	return "", false
1027: }

errors caused by workers unwinding, and\n\t// prevents post-deploy work from running against a partial lab.\n\tif err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tvar nodeFailErrs []error\n\tfor nodeErr := range nodeFailCh {\n\t\tnodeFailErrs = append(nodeFailErrs, nodeErr)\n\t}\n\tif len(nodeFailErrs) > 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\"deployment failed for one or more nodes: %w\",\n\t\t\terrors.Join(nodeFailErrs...),\n\t\t)\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// prepareLabManagementNetwork creates the management networks that are in use\n// and allocates addresses for the nodes attached to them.\nfunc (c *CLab) prepareLabManagementNetwork(\n\tctx context.Context,\n\texisting ...clabtypes.ExistingAddress,\n) error {\n\tif err := c.CreateNetwork(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tif err := c.allocateLabManagementIPs(ctx, existing); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\treturn c.setMgmtNetLinkBridges()\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) allocateLabManagementIPs(\n\tctx context.Context,\n\texisting []clabtypes.ExistingAddress,\n) error {\n\tpreferred := make(map[string]clabtypes.NodeAddresses)\n\tstate, err := c.LoadState()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Warn(\"Ignoring preferred management addresses\", \"error\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tif state != nil {\n\t\tfor name, addresses := range state.IPAM {\n\t\t\tpreferred[name] = addresses\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tfor _, m := range c.allMgmtNetworks() {\n\t\tif c.skipMgmtNetwork(m) {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tnodes := c.mgmtNetNodes(m)\n\t\tif m.IPAM.Provider == clabtypes.IPAMProviderRuntime || len(nodes) == 0 {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\n\t\treserved, err := c.collectReservedManagementAddresses(ctx, m, existing)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\n\t\terr = mgmt.AllocateManagementIPs(\n\t\t\tctx,\n\t\t\tm,\n\t\t\tnodes,\n\t\t\tclabtypes.AllocationOptions{\n\t\t\t\tExisting:  existing,\n\t\t\t\tPreferred: preferred,\n\t\t\t\tReserved:  reserved,\n\t\t\t},\n\t\t)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) collectReservedManagementAddresses(\n\tctx context.Context,\n\tm *clabtypes.MgmtNet,\n\texisting []clabtypes.ExistingAddress,\n) ([]netip.Addr, error) {\n\tvar subnets []netip.Prefix\n\tfor _, value := range []string{m.IPv4Subnet, m.IPv6Subnet} {\n\t\tif value == \"\" {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tsubnet, err := netip.ParsePrefix(value)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"management subnet %q: %w\", value, err)\n\t\t}\n\t\tsubnets = append(subnets, subnet)\n\t}\n\toccupied, err := c.globalRuntime().NetworkAddresses(ctx, subnets)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\ttype ownerAddress struct {\n\t\tcontainerID string\n\t\taddress     netip.Addr\n\t}\n\treused := make(map[ownerAddress]bool, len(existing))\n\tfor _, entry := range existing {\n\t\tif entry.ContainerID != \"\" {\n\t\t\treused[ownerAddress{entry.ContainerID, entry.Address}] = true\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tvar reserved []netip.Addr\n\tfor _, entry := range occupied {\n\t\tif entry.NetworkName == m.Network &&\n\t\t\treused[ownerAddress{entry.ContainerID, entry.Address}] {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\treserved = append(reserved, entry.Address)\n\t}\n\treturn reserved, nil\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) prepareDeployArtifacts(ctx context.Context, skipLabDirFileACLs bool) error {\n\tif err := c.loadKernelModules(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tc.prepareLabDirectory(skipLabDirFileACLs)\n\n\tif err := c.createPlaceholderArtifacts(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tif err := c.setupNodeAuth(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tc.populateExtraHosts()\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) prepareLabDirectory(skipFileACLs bool) {\n\tlog.Info(\"Creating lab directory\", \"path\", c.TopoPaths.TopologyLabDir())\n\tclabutils.CreateDirectory(c.TopoPaths.TopologyLabDir(), clabconstants.PermissionsDirDefault)\n\n\tif skipFileACLs {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\tif err := clabutils.AdjustFileACLs(c.TopoPaths.TopologyLabDir()); err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Infof(\"unable to adjust Labdir file ACLs: %v\", err)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) createPlaceholderArtifacts() error {\n\tclabutils.CreateDirectory(\n\t\tc.TopoPaths.CABaseDir(),\n\t\tclabconstants.PermissionsOpen,\n\t)\n\n\tpaths := []string{\n\t\tc.TopoPaths.AnsibleInventoryFileAbsPath(),\n\t\tc.TopoPaths.NornirSimpleInventoryFileAbsPath(),\n\t\tc.TopoPaths.TopoExportFile(),\n\t}\n\n\tfor _, path := range paths {\n\t\tif err := createEmptyFile(path); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc createEmptyFile(path string) error {\n\tf, err := os.Create(path)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\treturn f.Close()\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) setupNodeAuth(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tif err := c.certificateAuthoritySetup(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tvar err error\n\tc.SSHPubKeys, err = c.RetrieveSSHPubKeys(ctx)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Warn(err)\n\t}\n\n\treturn c.createAuthzKeysFile()\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) populateExtraHosts() {\n\textraHosts := make([]string, 0, len(c.Nodes))\n\n\tfor _, nodeName := range sortedNodeNames(c.Nodes) {\n\t\tn := c.Nodes[nodeName]\n\t\tif n.Config().MgmtIPv4Address != \"\" {\n\t\t\tlog.Debugf(\"Adding static ipv4 /etc/hosts entry for %s:%s\",\n\t\t\t\tn.Config().ShortName, n.Config().MgmtIPv4Address)\n\t\t\textraHosts = append(extraHosts, n.Config().ShortName+\":\"+n.Config().MgmtIPv4Address)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif n.Config().MgmtIPv6Address != \"\" {\n\t\t\tlog.Debugf(\"Adding static ipv6 /etc/hosts entry for %s:%s\",\n\t\t\t\tn.Config().ShortName, n.Config().MgmtIPv6Address)\n\t\t\textraHosts = append(extraHosts, n.Config().ShortName+\":\"+n.Config().MgmtIPv6Address)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tfor _, nodeName := range sortedNodeNames(c.Nodes) {\n\t\tn := c.Nodes[nodeName]\n\t\tif !strings.HasPrefix(n.Config().NetworkMode, \"container:\") {\n\t\t\tn.Config().ExtraHosts = extraHosts\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// certificateAuthoritySetup sets up the certificate authority parameters.\nfunc (c *CLab) certificateAuthoritySetup() error {\n\t// init the Cert storage and CA\n\tc.Cert.CertStorage = clabcert.NewLocalDirCertStorage(c.TopoPaths)\n\tc.Cert.CA = clabcert.NewCA()\n\n\ts := c.Config.Settings\n\n\t// Set defaults for the CA parameters\n\tkeySize := 2048\n\tvalidityDuration := time.Until(time.Now().AddDate(1, 0, 0)) // 1 year as default\n\tvar extCACert, extCAKey string\n\n\t// check that Settings.CertificateAuthority exists.\n\tif s != nil && s.CertificateAuthority != nil {\n\t\t// if ValidityDuration is set use the value\n\t\tif s.CertificateAuthority.ValidityDuration != 0 {\n\t\t\tvalidityDuration = s.CertificateAuthority.ValidityDuration\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// if KeyLength is set use the value\n\t\tif s.CertificateAuthority.KeySize != 0 {\n\t\t\tkeySize = s.CertificateAuthority.KeySize\n\t\t}\n\n\t\t// if external CA cert and key are set, propagate to topopaths\n\t\textCACert = s.CertificateAuthority.Cert\n\t\textCAKey = s.CertificateAuthority.Key\n\t}\n\n\t// override external ca and key from env vars\n\tif v := os.Getenv(\"CLAB_CA_KEY_FILE\"); v != \"\" {\n\t\textCAKey = v\n\t}\n\n\tif v := os.Getenv(\"CLAB_CA_CERT_FILE\"); v != \"\" {\n\t\textCACert = v\n\t}\n\n\tif extCACert != \"\" && extCAKey != \"\" {\n\t\terr := c.TopoPaths.SetExternalCaFiles(extCACert, extCAKey)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// define the attributes used to generate the CA Cert\n\tcaCertInput := &clabcert.CACSRInput{\n\t\tCommonName:   c.Config.Name + \" lab CA\",\n\t\tCountry:      \"US\",\n\t\tExpiry:       validityDuration,\n\t\tOrganization: \"containerlab\",\n\t\tKeySize:      keySize,\n\t}\n\n\treturn c.LoadOrGenerateCA(caCertInput)\n}\n\n// createNodes schedules nodes creation and returns a waitgroup for all nodes\n// with the exec collection created from the exec config of each node.\n// The exec collection is returned to the caller to ensure that the execution log\n// is printed after the nodes are created.\n// Nodes interdependencies are created in this function.\nfunc (c *CLab) createNodes(\n\tctx context.Context,\n\tmaxWorkers uint,\n\tskipPostDeploy bool,\n) (*sync.WaitGroup, *clabexec.ExecCollection, chan error, error) {\n\tfor _, node := range c.Nodes {\n\t\tc.dependencyManager.AddNode(node)\n\t}\n\n\t// nodes with static mgmt IP should be scheduled before the dynamic ones\n\terr := c.createStaticDynamicDependency()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, nil, nil, err\n\t}\n\n\t// create user-defined node dependencies done with `wait-for` property of the deployment stage\n\terr = c.createWaitForDependency()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, nil, nil, err\n\t}\n\n\t// make network namespace shared containers start in the right order\n\tc.createNamespaceSharingDependency()\n\n\t// Add possible additional dependencies here\n\n\t// make sure that there are no unresolvable dependencies, which would deadlock.\n\terr = c.dependencyManager.CheckAcyclicity()\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, nil, nil, err\n\t}\n\n\t// Buffered so workers never block reporting a failure (at most one failure path per node).\n\t// With zero nodes, nothing sends on this channel; an empty buffer is fine.\n\tnodeFailCh := make(chan error, len(c.Nodes))\n\n\t// start scheduling\n\tNodesWg, execCollection := c.scheduleNodes(ctx, int(maxWorkers), skipPostDeploy, nodeFailCh)\n\n\treturn NodesWg, execCollection, nodeFailCh, nil\n}\n\n// DeployNodes runs the node creation phase for the selected nodes.\nfunc (c *CLab) DeployNodes(\n\tctx context.Context,\n\tnodeNames []string,\n\tmaxWorkers uint,\n) error {\n\treturn c.deployNodes(ctx, nodeNames, maxWorkers, nil)\n}\n\n// deployApplyNodes schedules starts and creates together: a new sidecar can\n// depend on a stopped target, and a stopped node can depend on a new target.\nfunc (c *CLab) deployApplyNodes(ctx context.Context, plan *applyPlan, maxWorkers uint) error {\n\tnodeNames := sortedStringSet(\n\t\tunionStringSets(plan.addedNodeSet, plan.recreatedNodeSet, plan.startNodeSet),\n\t)\n\treturn c.deployNodes(ctx, nodeNames, maxWorkers, plan.startNodeSet)\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) deployNodes(\n\tctx context.Context,\n\tnodeNames []string,\n\tmaxWorkers uint,\n\tstartNodeSet map[string]struct{},\n) error {\n\tif len(nodeNames) == 0 {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\tif maxWorkers == 0 || int(maxWorkers) > len(nodeNames) {\n\t\tmaxWorkers = uint(len(nodeNames))\n\t}\n\tif _, err := c.networkModeNodeOrder(nodeNames); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tinput := make(chan string)\n\terrCh := make(chan error, len(nodeNames))\n\tcompleted := make(map[string]*nodeDeployCompletion, len(nodeNames))\n\tfor _, name := range nodeNames {\n\t\tcompleted[name] = &nodeDeployCompletion{done: make(chan struct{})}\n\t}\n\tfinish := func(name string, err error) {\n\t\tcompleted[name].err = err\n\t\tclose(completed[name].done)\n\t\terrCh <- err\n\t}\n\n\tfor range maxWorkers {\n\t\tgo func() {\n\t\t\tfor nodeName := range input {\n\t\t\t\tif _, start := startNodeSet[nodeName]; start {\n\t\t\t\t\tlog.Info(\"Starting stopped node\", \"node\", nodeName)\n\t\t\t\t\terr := c.Nodes[nodeName].Start(ctx)\n\t\t\t\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t\t\t\terr = fmt.Errorf(\"failed starting node %q: %w\", nodeName, err)\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t\tfinish(nodeName, err)\n\t\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\tlog.Info(\"Creating node\", \"node\", nodeName)\n\t\t\t\tfinish(nodeName, c.deployNode(ctx, c.Nodes[nodeName]))\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}()\n\t}\n\n\t// Wait outside the worker pool. Targets in this operation signal completion\n\t// directly, avoiding runtime polling and propagating failures to dependents.\n\tvar feedWg sync.WaitGroup\n\tfor _, nodeName := range nodeNames {\n\t\tfeedWg.Add(1)\n\t\tgo func(nodeName string) {\n\t\t\tdefer feedWg.Done()\n\t\t\tif err := c.waitForNodeDeployTarget(ctx, nodeName, completed); err != nil {\n\t\t\t\tfinish(nodeName, err)\n\t\t\t\treturn\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tselect {\n\t\t\tcase input <- nodeName:\n\t\t\tcase <-ctx.Done():\n\t\t\t\tfinish(nodeName, ctx.Err())\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}(nodeName)\n\t}\n\tgo func() {\n\t\tfeedWg.Wait()\n\t\tclose(input)\n\t}()\n\n\tvar errs []error\n\tfor range nodeNames {\n\t\tif err := <-errCh; err != nil {\n\t\t\terrs = append(errs, err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tif len(errs) > 0 {\n\t\treturn errors.Join(errs...)\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\ntype nodeDeployCompletion struct {\n\tdone chan struct{}\n\t// Closing done publishes err to dependent goroutines.\n\terr error\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) waitForNodeDeployTarget(\n\tctx context.Context,\n\tname string,\n\tcompleted map[string]*nodeDeployCompletion,\n) error {\n\tif err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\ttarget := networkModeContainerTarget(c.Nodes[name].Config().NetworkMode)\n\tif target == \"\" {\n\t\ttarget = c.Nodes[name].Config().Labels[clabnodestailscale.ParentLabel]\n\t}\n\tif completion, selected := completed[target]; selected {\n\t\tselect {\n\t\tcase <-completion.done:\n\t\t\tif completion.err != nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\n\t\t\t\t\t\"node %q depends on failed node %q: %w\",\n\t\t\t\t\tname,\n\t\t\t\t\ttarget,\n\t\t\t\t\tcompletion.err,\n\t\t\t\t)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\tcase <-ctx.Done():\n\t\t\treturn ctx.Err()\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn c.waitForApplyNetworkModeTarget(ctx, name)\n}\n\n// waitForApplyNetworkModeTarget waits until a node's network-mode:\n// container:<target> target is running, so apply's incremental deploy never\n// races a newly created or recreated target against its dependent. The\n// target may be a node in this same apply call (added or recreated\n// alongside the dependent) or, like fresh deploy, an external container not\n// managed by this topology.\nfunc (c *CLab) waitForApplyNetworkModeTarget(ctx context.Context, nodeName string) error {\n\tnode, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]\n\tif !exists {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\ttarget := networkModeContainerTarget(node.Config().NetworkMode)\n\tif target == \"\" {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\n\ttargetNode, internal := c.Nodes[target]\n\tif !internal {\n\t\treturn c.waitForExternalNodeDependencies(ctx, nodeName)\n\t}\n\n\truntime := c.globalRuntime()\n\tif runtime == nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"container runtime is not initialized\")\n\t}\n\n\treturn clabruntime.WaitForContainerRunning(ctx, runtime, targetNode.Config().LongName, nodeName)\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) deployNode(ctx context.Context, node clabnodes.Node) error {\n\tnodeName := node.GetShortName()\n\tif err := node.PreDeploy(ctx, &clabnodes.PreDeployParams{\n\t\tCert:         c.Cert,\n\t\tTopologyName: c.Config.Name,\n\t\tTopoPaths:    c.TopoPaths,\n\t\tSSHPubKeys:   c.SSHPubKeys,\n\t}); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node %q pre-deploy: %w\", nodeName, err)\n\t}\n\n\tif err := node.Deploy(ctx, &clabnodes.DeployParams{Nodes: c.Nodes}); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node %q deploy: %w\", nodeName, err)\n\t}\n\n\tif err := node.UpdateConfigWithRuntimeInfo(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Errorf(\"failed to update node runtime information for node %s: %v\", nodeName, err)\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// DeployLinks deploys selected links through their endpoints and runs their post-deploy hooks.\nfunc (c *CLab) DeployLinks(ctx context.Context, links []clablinks.Link) error {\n\treturn c.deployLinks(ctx, links, nil)\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) deployLinks(\n\tctx context.Context,\n\tlinks []clablinks.Link,\n\tadditionalNodeNames []string,\n) error {\n\ttouchedNodes := make(map[string]struct{}, len(additionalNodeNames))\n\tfor _, nodeName := range additionalNodeNames {\n\t\ttouchedNodes[nodeName] = struct{}{}\n\t}\n\tfor _, link := range links {\n\t\tlog.Info(\"Creating link\", \"link\", applyLinkName(link))\n\n\t\tfor _, ep := range clablinks.RuntimeEndpoints(link) {\n\t\t\tif err := ep.Deploy(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed deploying link %s: %w\", applyLinkName(link), err)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\ttouchedNodes[ep.GetNode().GetShortName()] = struct{}{}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif err := link.PostDeploy(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed post-deploying link %s: %w\", applyLinkName(link), err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tfor _, nodeName := range sortedStringSet(touchedNodes) {\n\t\tnode, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]\n\t\tif !exists {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := node.PostDeployEndpoints(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node %q post-deploy links: %w\", nodeName, err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) postDeployApplyNodes(\n\tctx context.Context,\n\tnodeNames []string,\n\tskipPostDeploy bool,\n) error {\n\texecCollection := clabexec.NewExecCollection()\n\n\tfor _, nodeName := range nodeNames {\n\t\tnode := c.Nodes[nodeName]\n\n\t\tif !skipPostDeploy {\n\t\t\tif err := node.PostDeploy(\n\t\t\t\tctx,\n\t\t\t\t&clabnodes.PostDeployParams{Nodes: c.Nodes},\n\t\t\t); err != nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node %q post-deploy: %w\", nodeName, err)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tif err := node.RunExecFromConfig(ctx, execCollection); err != nil {\n\t\t\tlog.Errorf(\"failed to run exec commands for %s: %v\", nodeName, err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\texecCollection.Log()\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) finalize(\n\tctx context.Context,\n\texportTemplate string,\n\tgraph bool,\n) ([]clabruntime.GenericContainer, error) {\n\tif err := c.GenerateInventories(); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\ttopoDataF, err := os.Create(c.TopoPaths.TopoExportFile())\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tdefer topoDataF.Close()\n\n\tif err := c.GenerateExports(ctx, topoDataF, exportTemplate); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tif graph {\n\t\tif err := c.GenerateDotGraph(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\t\tlog.Error(err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tcontainers, err := c.ListNodesContainers(ctx)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\tif !c.mgmtNetworksSkipped() {\n\t\tlog.Info(\"Adding host entries\", \"path\", \"/etc/hosts\")\n\t\tif err := c.appendHostsFileEntries(ctx); err != nil {\n\t\t\tlog.Errorf(\"failed to create hosts file: %v\", err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tlog.Info(\"Adding SSH config for nodes\", \"path\", c.TopoPaths.SSHConfigPath())\n\tif err := c.addSSHConfig(); err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Errorf(\"failed to create ssh config file: %v\", err)\n\t}\n\n\tc.writeState()\n\n\treturn containers, nil\n}\n\nfunc (c *CLab) writeState() {\n\tif err := c.WriteState(); err != nil {\n\t\tlog.Warnf(\"failed to write state file: %v\", err)\n\t}\n}\n\n// configureSnapshotRestore configures nodes for snapshot restoration.\n// It resolves snapshot files for each node and adds the necessary volume mounts\n// and environment variables to restore from snapshots.\nfunc (c *CLab) configureSnapshotRestore(options *DeployOptions) error {\n\t// Build restore map from per-node specifications\n\trestoreMap := make(map[string]string)\n\tfor _, mapping := range options.restoreNodeSnapshots {\n\t\tparts := strings.SplitN(mapping, \"=\", 2)\n\t\tif len(parts) != 2 {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"invalid restore format: %s (expected: node=path)\", mapping)\n\t\t}\n\t\trestoreMap[parts[0]] = parts[1]\n\t}\n\n\t// Track statistics for logging\n\tvar restoredCount, freshCount int\n\n\t// Configure each node\n\tfor _, node := range c.Nodes {\n\t\tnodeName := node.Config().ShortName\n\n\t\t// Resolve snapshot path for this node\n\t\tsnapshotPath, shouldRestore := resolveNodeSnapshot(nodeName, restoreMap, options.restoreAll)\n\n\t\tif shouldRestore {\n\t\t\t// Validate snapshot file exists\n\t\t\tif _, err := os.Stat(snapshotPath); os.IsNotExist(err) {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"snapshot file not found for node %s: %s\", nodeName, snapshotPath)\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t// Get absolute path for bind mount\n\t\t\tabsPath, err := filepath.Abs(snapshotPath)\n\t\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"failed to get absolute path for %s: %w\", snapshotPath, err)\n\t\t\t}\n\n\t\t\t// Add volume mount for snapshot (read-only)\n\t\t\tnode.Config().Binds = append(node.Config().Binds,\n\t\t\t\tfmt.Sprintf(\"%s:/snapshot.tar:ro\", absPath))\n\n\t\t\t// Add restore environment variable\n\t\t\tif node.Config().Env == nil {\n\t\t\t\tnode.Config().Env = make(map[string]string)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tnode.Config().Env[\"RESTORE_SNAPSHOT\"] = \"1\"\n\n\t\t\tlog.Infof(\"Node %s will restore from: %s\", nodeName, snapshotPath)\n\t\t\trestoredCount++\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tfreshCount++\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Log deployment mode summary if any restores are configured\n\tif restoredCount > 0 {\n\t\tlog.Infof(\"Deploying %d nodes from snapshots, %d nodes fresh\", restoredCount, freshCount)\n\t}\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// resolveNodeSnapshot determines the snapshot file path for a given node.\n// Priority: per-node override > restore-all directory > none.\nfunc resolveNodeSnapshot(\n\tnodeName string,\n\trestoreMap map[string]string,\n\trestoreAll string,\n) (string, bool) {\n\t// 1. 1: package links
2: 
3: import (
4: 	"fmt"
5: 	"math"
6: 	"slices"
7: 	"time"
8: )
9: 
10: // maxNetemJitter is the highest jitter the kernel accepts without capping it.
11: const maxNetemJitter = math.MaxInt32 * time.Nanosecond
12: 
13: // maxNetemRate is the highest rate in kbit/s that can be converted to bytes/s.
14: const maxNetemRate = math.MaxUint64 / 1000
15: 
16: // NetemRaw is the link impairment of an endpoint as defined in the topology file.
17: // It applies to the packets the endpoint's interface sends.
18: type NetemRaw struct {
19: 	Delay      string  `yaml:"delay,omitempty"`
20: 	Jitter     string  `yaml:"jitter,omitempty"`
21: 	Loss       float64 `yaml:"loss,omitempty"`
22: 	Rate       uint64  `yaml:"rate,omitempty"`
23: 	Corruption float64 `yaml:"corruption,omitempty"`
24: }
25: 
26: // Netem is the resolved link impairment of an endpoint.
27: type Netem struct {
28: 	Delay      time.Duration
29: 	Jitter     time.Duration
30: 	Loss       float64
31: 	Rate       uint64
32: 	Corruption float64
33: }
34: 
35: // Resolve validates the impairment and returns nil if it sets nothing.
36: func (r *NetemRaw) Resolve() (*Netem, error) {
37: 	if r == nil {
38: 		return nil, nil
39: 	}
40: 
41: 	netem := &Netem{Loss: r.Loss, Rate: r.Rate, Corruption: r.Corruption}
42: 
43: 	var err error
44: 	if netem.Delay, err = parseNetemDuration("delay", r.Delay); err != nil {
45: 		return nil, err
46: 	}
47: 	if netem.Jitter, err = parseNetemDuration("jitter", r.Jitter); err != nil {
48: 		return nil, err
49: 	}
50: 
51: 	if netem.Jitter != 0 && netem.Delay == 0 {
52: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("netem jitter cannot be set without setting delay")
53: 	}
54: 	if netem.Jitter > maxNetemJitter {
55: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("netem jitter must be at most %s", maxNetemJitter)
56: 	}
57: 	if !(netem.Loss >= 0 && netem.Loss <= 100) {
58: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("netem loss must be in the range between 0 and 100")
59: 	}
60: 	if !(netem.Corruption >= 0 && netem.Corruption <= 100) {
61: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("netem corruption must be in the range between 0 and 100")
62: 	}
63: 
64: 	if netem.Rate > maxNetemRate {
65: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("netem rate must be at most %d kbit/s", uint64(maxNetemRate))
66: 	}
67: 
68: 	if *netem == (Netem{}) {
69: 		return nil, nil
70: 	}
71: 
72: 	return netem, nil
73: }
74: 
75: func parseNetemDuration(name, value string) (time.Duration, error) {
76: 	if value == "" {
77: 		return 0, nil
78: 	}
79: 
80: 	duration, err := time.ParseDuration(value)
81: 	if err != nil {
82: 		return 0, fmt.Errorf("netem %s %q is not a duration, e.g. 100ms: %w", name, value, err)
83: 	}
84: 	if duration < 0 {
85: 		return 0, fmt.Errorf("netem %s %q must not be negative", name, value)
86: 	}
87: 
88: 	return duration, nil
89: }
90: 
91: func declaresNetem(e *EndpointRaw) bool {
92: 	return e != nil && e.Netem != nil && *e.Netem != (NetemRaw{})
93: }
94: 
95: // checkNetemOnVeth rejects link impairments on the endpoints of a link that is not a veth link.
96: func checkNetemOnVeth(lt LinkType, endpoints ...*EndpointRaw) error {
97: 	if slices.ContainsFunc(endpoints, declaresNetem) {
98: 		return fmt.Errorf("netem is only supported on veth links, not on %s links", lt)
99: 	}
100: 
101: 	return nil
102: }
103: 
104: // DeclaresNetem reports whether the link sets a link impairment on any of its endpoints.
105: func (ld *LinkDefinition) DeclaresNetem() bool {
106: 	var endpoints []*EndpointRaw
107: 
108: 	switch l := ld.Link.(type) {
109: 	case *LinkVEthRaw:
110: 		endpoints = l.Endpoints
111: 	case *LinkVEthStitchedRaw:
112: 		endpoints = l.Endpoints
113: 	case *LinkHostRaw:
114: 		endpoints = []*EndpointRaw{l.Endpoint}
115: 	case *LinkMacVlanRaw:
116: 		endpoints = []*EndpointRaw{l.Endpoint}
117: 	case *LinkMgmtNetRaw:
118: 		endpoints = []*EndpointRaw{l.Endpoint}
119: 	case *LinkDummyRaw:
120: 		endpoints = []*EndpointRaw{l.Endpoint}
121: 	case *LinkVxlanRaw:
122: 		endpoints = []*EndpointRaw{&l.Endpoint}
123: 	}
124: 
125: 	return slices.ContainsFunc(endpoints, declaresNetem)

16: // LinkVEthRaw is the raw (string) representation of a veth link as defined in the topology file.
17: type LinkVEthRaw struct {
18: 	LinkCommonParams `               yaml:",inline"`
19: 	Endpoints        []*EndpointRaw `yaml:"endpoints"`
20: 	fromBrief        bool
21: }
22: 
23: // ToLinkBriefRaw converts the raw link into a LinkBriefRaw.
24: func (r *LinkVEthRaw) ToLinkBriefRaw() *LinkBriefRaw {
25: 	lc := &LinkBriefRaw{
26: 		Endpoints:        []string{},
27: 		LinkCommonParams: r.LinkCommonParams,
28: 	}
29: 
30: 	for _, e := range r.Endpoints {
31: 		lc.Endpoints = append(lc.Endpoints, fmt.Sprintf("%s:%s", e.Node, e.Iface))
32: 	}
33: 
34: 	if slices.ContainsFunc(r.Endpoints, func(e *EndpointRaw) bool { return e.Netem != nil }) {
35: 		for _, e := range r.Endpoints {
36: 			lc.Netem = append(lc.Netem, e.Netem)
37: 		}
38: 	}
39: 
40: 	return lc
41: }
42: 
43: func (*LinkVEthRaw) GetType() LinkType {
44: 	return LinkTypeVEth
45: }

47: // Resolve resolves the raw veth link definition into a Link interface that is implemented
48: // by a concrete LinkVEth struct.
49: // Resolving a veth link resolves its endpoints.
50: func (r *LinkVEthRaw) Resolve(params *ResolveParams) (Link, error) {
51: 	// filtered true means the link is in the filter provided by a user
52: 	// aka it should be resolved/created/deployed
53: 	filtered := isInFilter(params, r.Endpoints)
54: 	if !filtered {
55: 		return nil, nil
56: 	}
57: 
58: 	if r.fromBrief && r.briefDefaultLinkType(params) == LinkTypeVethStitch {
59: 		return NewVEthStitchedRawFromVEth(r).Resolve(params)
60: 	}
61: 
62: 	// create LinkVEth struct
63: 	l := NewLinkVEth()
64: 	l.LinkCommonParams = r.LinkCommonParams
65: 
66: 	// Normalize link vars to ensure JSON serialization compatibility
67: 	l.Vars = normalizeVars(l.Vars)
68: 
69: 	// resolve raw endpoints (epr) to endpoints (ep)
70: 	for _, epr := range r.Endpoints {
71: 		if (epr.Node == "host" || epr.Node == "mgmt-net") && declaresNetem(epr) {
72: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("netem is not supported on %s endpoints", epr.Node)
73: 		}
74: 
75: 		ep, err := epr.Resolve(params, l)
76: 		if err != nil {
77: 			return nil, err
78: 		}
79: 
80: 		// add endpoint to the link endpoints
81: 		l.Endpoints = append(l.Endpoints, ep)
82: 	}
83: 
84: 	// set default link mtu if MTU is unset
85: 	if l.MTU == 0 {
86: 		l.MTU = clabconstants.DefaultLinkMTU
87: 	}
88: 
89: 	return l, nil
90: }

92: // linkVEthRawFromLinkBriefRaw creates a raw veth link from a LinkBriefRaw.
93: func linkVEthRawFromLinkBriefRaw(lb *LinkBriefRaw) (*LinkVEthRaw, error) {
94: 	host, hostIf, node, nodeIf, err := extractHostNodeInterfaceData(lb, 0)
95: 	if err != nil {
96: 		return nil, err
97: 	}
98: 
99: 	link := &LinkVEthRaw{
100: 		LinkCommonParams: lb.LinkCommonParams,
101: 		Endpoints: []*EndpointRaw{
102: 			NewEndpointRaw(host, hostIf, ""),
103: 			NewEndpointRaw(node, nodeIf, ""),
104: 		},
105: 	}
106: 
107: 	// populate vars
108: 	if err := mapBriefVarsToEndpoints(lb, link.Endpoints); err != nil {
109: 		return nil, err
110: 	}
111: 
112: 	if len(lb.Netem) > len(link.Endpoints) {
113: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("number of netem entries exceeds the number of endpoints")
114: 	}
115: 	for i, netem := range lb.Netem {
116: 		link.Endpoints[i].Netem = netem
117: 	}
118: 
119: 	// set default link mtu if MTU is unset
120: 	if link.MTU == 0 {
121: 		link.MTU = clabconstants.DefaultLinkMTU
122: 	}
123: 
124: 	return link, nil
125: }

130: 	nodesFilter []string,

141: // defaultLinkTypeProvider is a type that can provide the default link type for a node. Currently

143: type defaultLinkTypeProvider interface {
144: 	DefaultLinkType() LinkType

147: func (r *LinkVEthRaw) briefDefaultLinkType(params *ResolveParams) LinkType {
148: 	for _, ep := range r.Endpoints {
149: 		n, ok := params.Nodes[ep.Node]
150: 		if !ok {
151: 			continue
152: 		}
153: 
154: 		provider, ok := n.(defaultLinkTypeProvider)
155: 		if !ok {
156: 			continue
157: 		}
158: 
159: 		lt := provider.DefaultLinkType()
160: 		if lt != "" && lt != LinkTypeVEth {
161: 			return lt
162: 		}
163: 	}
164: 
165: 	return LinkTypeVEth
166: }

185: func (l *LinkVEth) deployAEnd(ctx context.Context, idx int) error {
186: 	ep := l.Endpoints[idx]
187: 	// the peer Endpoint is the other of the two endpoints in the
188: 	// Endpoints slice. So do a +1 on the index and modulo operation
189: 	// to take care of the wrap around.
190: 	peerIdx := (idx + 1) % 2
191: 	peerEp := l.Endpoints[peerIdx]
192: 
193: 	log.Debugf("Creating Endpoint: %s ( --> %s )", ep, peerEp)
194: 
195: 	// build the netlink.Veth struct for the link provisioning
196: 	linkA := &netlink.Veth{
197: 		LinkAttrs: netlink.LinkAttrs{
198: 			Name: ep.GetRandIfaceName(),
199: 			MTU:  l.MTU,
200: 			// Mac address is set later on
201: 		},
202: 		PeerName: peerEp.GetRandIfaceName(),
203: 		// PeerMac address is set later on
204: 	}
205: 
206: 	// add the link
207: 	err := netlink.LinkAdd(linkA)
208: 	if err != nil {
209: 		return err
210: 	}
211: 
212: 	// cleanup is a helper that removes the veth pair if a subsequent step fails
213: 	// after LinkAdd succeeded, preventing orphaned interfaces from blocking retries.
214: 	cleanup := func(err error) error {
215: 		if delErr := netlink.LinkDel(linkA); delErr != nil {
216: 			log.Debugf(
217: 				"failed to cleanup veth pair %s after error: %v",
218: 				ep.GetRandIfaceName(),
219: 				delErr,
220: 			)
221: 		}
222: 		return err
223: 	}
224: 
225: 	// disable TXOffloading
226: 	if err := clabutils.EthtoolTXOff(ep.GetRandIfaceName()); err != nil {
227: 		return cleanup(err)
228: 	}
229: 
230: 	// the link needs to be moved to the relevant network namespace
231: 	// and enabled (up). This is done via linkSetupFunc.
232: 	// based on the endpoint type the link setup function is different.
233: 	// linkSetupFunc is executed in a netns of a node.
234: 	// if the node is a regular namespace node
235: 	// add link to node, rename, set mac and Up
236: 	err = ep.GetNode().AddLinkToContainer(ctx, linkA,
237: 		SetNameMACAndUpInterface(linkA, ep))
238: 	if err != nil {
239: 		return cleanup(err)
240: 	}
241: 
242: 	l.DeploymentState = LinkDeploymentStateHalfDeployed
243: 
244: 	// e.g. host endpoints are nodeless, and therefore the B end of the veth link should
245: 	// be deployed right after the A end is deployed.
246: 	if peerEp.IsNodeless() {
247: 		return l.deployBEnd(ctx, peerIdx)
248: 	}
249: 
250: 	return nil
251: }
252: 
253: func (l *LinkVEth) deployBEnd(ctx context.Context, idx int) error {
254: 	ep := l.Endpoints[idx]
255: 	peerEp := l.Endpoints[(idx+1)%2]
256: 
257: 	log.Debugf("Assigning Endpoint: %s ( --> %s )", ep, peerEp)
258: 
259: 	// retrieve the netlink.Link for the provided Endpoint
260: 	link, err := netlink.LinkByName(ep.GetRandIfaceName())
261: 	if err != nil {
262: 		return err
263: 	}
264: 
265: 	// disable TXOffloading
266: 	if err := clabutils.EthtoolTXOff(ep.GetRandIfaceName()); err != nil {
267: 		return err
268: 	}
269: 
270: 	// Host endpoints already live in the current namespace; set them up in place.
271: 	// Other nodeless endpoints, such as the management bridge, still need their
272: 	// node-specific setup.
273: 	if ep.IsNodeless() && ep.GetNode().GetLinkEndpointType() == LinkEndpointTypeHost {
274: 		if err := SetNameMACAndUpInterface(link, ep)(nil); err != nil {
275: 			return err
276: 		}
277: 	} else if err = ep.GetNode().AddLinkToContainer(ctx, link,
278: 		SetNameMACAndUpInterface(link, ep)); err != nil {
279: 		return err
280: 	}
281: 
282: 	l.DeploymentState = LinkDeploymentStateFullDeployed
283: 
284: 	if len(l.Endpoints) == 2 {
285: 		log.Infof("Created link: %s ▪┄┄▪ %s", l.Endpoints[0], l.Endpoints[1])
286: 	}
287: 
288: 	return nil
289: }
290: 
291: // getEndpointIndex returns the index of the ep endpoint belonging to l link.
292: // An error is returned when the ep is not part of the l's endpoints.
293: func (l *LinkVEth) getEndpointIndex(ep Endpoint) (int, error) {
294: 	for idx, e := range l.Endpoints {
295: 		if e == ep {
296: 			return idx, nil
297: 		}
298: 	}
299: 
300: 	// if the endpoint is not part of the link
301: 	// build a string list of endpoints and return a meaningful error
302: 	var epStrings []string
303: 	for _, e := range l.Endpoints {
304: 		epStrings = append(epStrings, e.String())
305: 	}
306: 
307: 	return -1, fmt.Errorf(
308: 		"endpoint %s does not belong to link [ %s ]",
309: 		ep.String(),
310: 		strings.Join(epStrings, ", "),
311: 	)
312: }
313: 
314: // Deploy deploys the veth link by creating the A and B sides of the veth pair independently
315: // based on the calling endpoint.
316: func (l *LinkVEth) Deploy(ctx context.Context, ep Endpoint) error {
317: 	// since each node calls deploy on its links, we need to make sure that we only deploy
318: 	// the link once, even if multiple nodes call deploy on the same link.
319: 	l.deployMutex.Lock()
320: 	defer l.deployMutex.Unlock()
321: 
322: 	// first we need to check that the provided ep is part of this link
323: 	idx, err := l.getEndpointIndex(ep)
324: 	if err != nil {
325: 		return err
326: 	}
327: 
328: 	// Retry transient netlink errors that can occur during concurrent link operations.
329: 	// deployAEnd cleans up partial state on failure, making each retry idempotent.
330: 	return retryTransientNetlink(ctx, fmt.Sprintf("deploy link %s", ep), func() error {
331: 		switch l.DeploymentState {
332: 		case LinkDeploymentStateHalfDeployed:
333: 			return l.deployBEnd(ctx, idx)
334: 		case LinkDeploymentStateFullDeployed:
335: 			return nil
336: 		default:
337: 			return l.deployAEnd(ctx, idx)
338: 		}
339: 	})
340: }
341: 
342: func (*LinkVEth) PostDeploy(context.Context) error {
343: 	return nil
344: }
345: 
346: func (l *LinkVEth) Remove(ctx context.Context) error {
347: 	l.deployMutex.Lock()
348: 	defer l.deployMutex.Unlock()
349: 	if l.DeploymentState == LinkDeploymentStateRemoved {
350: 		return nil
351: 	}
352: 	for _, ep := range l.GetEndpoints() {
353: 		err := ep.Remove(ctx)
354: 		if err != nil {
355: 			log.Debug(err)
356: 		}
357: 	}
358: 	l.DeploymentState = LinkDeploymentStateRemoved
359: 	return nil
360: }
361: 
362: func (l *LinkVEth) GetEndpoints() []Endpoint {
363: 	return l.Endpoints
364: }
365: 
366: func (l *LinkVEth) GetRuntimeEndpoints() []Endpoint {
367: 	return l.GetEndpoints()
368: }

Reasoning
Notable: `EndpointRaw.Resolve` calls `er.Netem.Resolve()` — but `er.Netem` may be nil; `Resolve()` has nil-receiver check. Good.

Note in `linkVEthRawFromLinkBriefRaw`: `link.Endpoints[i].Netem = netem` — `lb.Netem` is `[]*NetemRaw`. And `ToLinkBriefRaw` only appends Netem if some endpoint has non-nil Netem. But what if a brief link has `netem: [null, null]`? Schema allows null entries (object-or-null). Then `e.Netem` nil for both... `ToLinkBriefRaw` checks `e.Netem != nil`. For brief-parsed links, `lb.Netem` entries could be null — `declaresNetem` false → no error, no impairment. Fine.

Now `linkVEthRawFromLinkBriefRaw` — brief veth with netem then converted to veth-stitch via `NewVEthStitchedRawFromVEth(r)` when `briefDefaultLinkType` is VethStitch (SR-SIM). Netem carries through. Then LinkVEthStitchedRaw.Resolve — need to check whether it rejects netem. Earlier note said it doesn't. Let me read link_veth_stitched.go fully, endpoint.go, link_brief.go, and the other link type files.

71: // LinkVEthStitched is the resolved veth-stitch link: two veth segments
72: // (nodeA<->root-ns, nodeB<->root-ns) whose root-ns ends are joined by a tc stitch.
73: type LinkVEthStitched struct {
74: 	LinkCommonParams
75: 
76: 	lifecycleMutex sync.Mutex
77: 
78: 	// since the stitch veth lives in the root ns, we need to ensure altnames
79: 	// are per-lab unique.
80: 	labName string
81: 
82: 	segA *LinkVEth
83: 	segB *LinkVEth
84:

86: 	epA Endpoint
87: 	epB Endpoint

91: 	return LinkTypeVethStitch
92: }

95: 	return []Endpoint{l.segA.Endpoints[0], l.segB.Endpoints[0]}
96: }

99: func (l *LinkVEthStitched) GetRuntimeEndpoints() []Endpoint {
100: 	return []Endpoint{l.segA.Endpoints[0], l.segB.Endpoints[0], l.epA, l.epB}
101: }

103: // Deploy creates the veth segment belonging to ep.
104: func (l *LinkVEthStitched) Deploy(ctx context.Context, ep Endpoint) error {
105: 	l.lifecycleMutex.Lock()
106: 	defer l.lifecycleMutex.Unlock()
107: 
108: 	if l.DeploymentState == LinkDeploymentStateFullDeployed {
109: 		return nil
110: 	}
111: 
112: 	var err error
113: 	switch ep {
114: 	case l.segA.Endpoints[0]:
115: 		err = l.segA.Deploy(ctx, ep)
116: 	case l.segB.Endpoints[0]:
117: 		err = l.segB.Deploy(ctx, ep)
118: 	default:
119: 		return fmt.Errorf("endpoint %s does not belong to link [ %s, %s ]",
120: 			ep, l.segA.Endpoints[0], l.segB.Endpoints[0])
121: 	}
122: 	if err != nil {
123: 		return err
124: 	}
125: 
126: 	l.DeploymentState = LinkDeploymentStateHalfDeployed
127: 
128: 	if l.segA.DeploymentState == LinkDeploymentStateFullDeployed &&
129: 		l.segB.DeploymentState == LinkDeploymentStateFullDeployed {
130: 		return l.stitchSegments(ctx)
131: 	}
132: 
133: 	return nil
134: }
135: 
136: // PostDeploy tags the two root-ns far ends and joins them with tc.
137: // if they weren't already stitched in Deploy.
138: func (l *LinkVEthStitched) PostDeploy(ctx context.Context) error {
139: 	l.lifecycleMutex.Lock()
140: 	defer l.lifecycleMutex.Unlock()
141: 
142: 	if l.DeploymentState == LinkDeploymentStateFullDeployed {
143: 		return nil
144: 	}
145: 	if l.segA.DeploymentState != LinkDeploymentStateFullDeployed ||
146: 		l.segB.DeploymentState != LinkDeploymentStateFullDeployed {
147: 		return fmt.Errorf("cannot stitch veth segments before both are fully deployed")
148: 	}
149: 
150: 	return l.stitchSegments(ctx)
151: }
152: 
153: func (l *LinkVEthStitched) stitchSegments(ctx context.Context) error {
154: 	steps := []func() error{
155: 		func() error { return markFarEnd(l.epB, l.segA.Endpoints[0], l.labName) },
156: 		func() error { return markFarEnd(l.epA, l.segB.Endpoints[0], l.labName) },
157: 		func() error { return stitch(l.epA, l.epB) },
158: 		func() error { return stitch(l.epB, l.epA) },
159: 	}
160: 	for _, step := range steps {
161: 		if err := retryTransientNetlink(ctx, "veth-stitch", step); err != nil {
162: 			return err
163: 		}
164: 	}
165: 
166: 	l.DeploymentState = LinkDeploymentStateFullDeployed
167: 
168: 	return nil
169: }

172: 	l.lifecycleMutex.Lock()
173: 	defer l.lifecycleMutex.Unlock()
174: 
175: 	if l.DeploymentState == LinkDeploymentStateRemoved {
176: 		return nil
177: 	}
178:

180: 
181: 	l.DeploymentState = LinkDeploymentStateRemoved

189: 	params *ResolveParams,
190: 	owner *LinkVEthStitched,
191: 	nodeEpRaw *EndpointRaw,
192: 	mtu int,
193: ) (*LinkVEth, Endpoint, error) {
194: 	seg := NewLinkVEth()
195: 	seg.MTU = mtu
196: 
197: 	nodeEp, err := nodeEpRaw.Resolve(params, owner)
198: 	if err != nil {
199: 		return nil, nil, err
200: 	}
201: 
202: 	// the far end sits in the root namespace (host node) with a short hash name
203: 	// that fits the 15 char name limit.
204: 	farName := stitchFarEndName(params.LabName, nodeEpRaw.Node, nodeEpRaw.Iface)
205: 	farGeneric := NewEndpointGeneric(GetHostLinkNode(), farName, seg)
206: 	farGeneric.MAC = nodeEp.GetMac()
207: 	farEp := NewEndpointHost(farGeneric)
208: 	seg.Endpoints = []Endpoint{nodeEp, farEp}
209: 
210: 	return seg, farEp, nil
211: }
212: 
213: func stitchFarEndName(labName, node, iface string) string {
214: 	sum := sha1.Sum([]byte(labName + "\x00" + node + "\x00" + iface))
215: 	return "clab-s-" + hex.EncodeToString(sum[:4]) // 7 + 8 = 15 chars
216: }
217: 
218: func markFarEnd(farEp, nodeEp Endpoint, labName string) error {
219: 	l, err := netlink.LinkByName(farEp.GetIfaceName())
220: 	if err != nil {
221: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to look up veth-stitch far end %q: %w", farEp.GetIfaceName(), err)
222: 	}
223: 
224: 	iface := nodeEp.GetIfaceAlias()
225: 	if iface == "" {
226: 		iface = nodeEp.GetIfaceName()
227: 	}
228: 
229: 	altName := StitchAltName(labName, nodeEp.GetNode().GetShortName(), iface)
230: 	if err := netlink.LinkAddAltName(l, altName); err != nil && !isAltNameNotSupportedErr(err) {
231: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to add veth-stitch altname %q: %w", altName, err)
232: 	}
233: 
234: 	return nil
235: }
236: 
237: func validateVEthStitched(r *LinkVEthStitchedRaw) error {
238: 	if len(r.Endpoints) != 2 {
239: 		return fmt.Errorf(
240: 			"veth-stitch links require exactly two endpoints, got %d",
241: 			len(r.Endpoints),
242: 		)
243: 	}
244: 
245: 	return nil
246: }
247: 
248: func (r *LinkVEthStitchedRaw) cleanupFilteredLink(
249: 	ctx context.Context,
250: 	labName string,
251: 	nodesFilter []string,
252: ) error {
253: 	return cleanupFilteredVethStitch(ctx, labName, nodesFilter, r.Endpoints)
254: }
255: 
256: func cleanupFilteredVethStitch(
257: 	ctx context.Context,
258: 	labName string,
259: 	nodesFilter []string,
260: 	endpoints []*EndpointRaw,
261: ) error {
262: 	for _, altName := range filteredVethStitchAltNames(labName, nodesFilter, endpoints) {
263: 		if err := RemoveOwnedInterface(ctx, GetHostLinkNode(), altName); err != nil {
264: 			return fmt.Errorf("failed cleaning up veth-stitch interface %q: %w", altName, err)
265: 		}
266: 	}
267: 
268: 	return nil
269: }
270: 
271: func filteredVethStitchAltNames(
272: 	labName string,
273: 	nodesFilter []string,
274: 	endpoints []*EndpointRaw,
275: ) []string {
276: 	names := make(map[string]struct{})
277: 	for _, ep := range endpoints {
278: 		if ep == nil || ep.Node == "" || ep.Iface == "" ||
279: 			!slices.Contains(nodesFilter, ep.Node) {
280: 			continue
281: 		}
282: 		names[StitchAltName(labName, ep.Node, ep.Iface)] = struct{}{}
283: 	}
284: 
285: 	result := make([]string, 0, len(names))
286: 	for name := range names {
287: 		result = append(result, name)
288: 	}
289: 	sort.Strings(result)
290: 
291: 	return result
292: }
293: 
294: // StitchAltName returns a unique name for veth-stitch links.
295: func StitchAltName(labName, node, iface string) string {
296: 	return "clab-stitch-" + clabutils.SanitizeInterfaceName(labName+"-"+node+"-"+iface)
297: }
298: 
299: // ToolsInterface returns the host-netns interface veth-stitch (and similar
300: // kinds) publish for node:iface under StitchAltName, or (nil, false) if none.
301: // Single seam for reporting/impairing the host side of the stitch.
302: func ToolsInterface(labName, node, iface string) (netlink.Link, bool) {
303: 	if labName == "" || node == "" || iface == "" {
304: 		return nil, false
305: 	}
306: 
307: 	link, err := netlink.LinkByName(StitchAltName(labName, node, iface))
308: 	if err != nil {
309: 		return nil, false
310: 	}
311: 
312: 	return link, true
313: }

16: // Endpoint is the interface that all endpoint types implement.
17: // Endpoints like bridge, host, veth and macvlan are the types implementing this interface.

19: 	// Deploy deploys this endpoint through its associated link.

147: func (e *EndpointGeneric) Remove(ctx context.Context) error {
148: 	return e.GetNode().ExecFunction(ctx, func(ns.NetNS) error {
149: 		brSideEp, err := netlink.LinkByName(clabutils.SanitizeInterfaceName(e.GetIfaceName()))
150: 		_, notfound := err.(netlink.LinkNotFoundError)
151: 
152: 		switch {
153: 		case notfound:
154: 			// The netdev may already be gone while its bridge port is not, which is how OVS
155: 			// keeps a port whose name is not the topology interface name.
156: 			return removeBridgePort(e.GetNode(), e.GetIfaceName())
157: 		case err != nil:
158: 			return err
159: 		}
160: 		log.Debugf(
161: 			"Removing interface %q from namespace %q",
162: 			e.GetIfaceName(),
163: 			e.GetNode().GetShortName(),
164: 		)
165: 		if err = netlink.LinkDel(brSideEp); err != nil {
166: 			return err
167: 		}
168: 
169: 		return removeBridgePort(e.GetNode(), e.GetIfaceName())
170: 	})
171: }

173: // moveEndpoint moves the endpoint's interface into dst's namespace and transfers ownership.
174: // The interface is left in the DOWN state; callers that need it active should follow up with
175: // Endpoint.Activate once all endpoints are in place.
176: func moveEndpoint(ctx context.Context, e Endpoint, dst Node) error {
177: 	src := e.GetNode()
178: 	if src == nil {
179: 		return fmt.Errorf("endpoint %q has no source node", e.GetIfaceName())
180: 	}
181: 
182: 	if dst == nil {
183: 		return fmt.Errorf("endpoint %q has no destination node", e.GetIfaceName())
184: 	}
185: 
186: 	if src == dst {
187: 		return nil
188: 	}
189: 
190: 	if !slices.Contains(src.GetEndpoints(), e) {
191: 		return fmt.Errorf("node %q does not own endpoint %q", src.GetShortName(), e.GetIfaceName())
192: 	}
193: 
194: 	for _, owned := range dst.GetEndpoints() {
195: 		if owned == e {
196: 			return fmt.Errorf(
197: 				"node %q already owns endpoint %q",
198: 				dst.GetShortName(),
199: 				e.GetIfaceName(),
200: 			)
201: 		}
202: 		if owned.GetIfaceName() == e.GetIfaceName() {
203: 			return fmt.Errorf(
204: 				"node %q already tracks interface %q",
205: 				dst.GetShortName(),
206: 				e.GetIfaceName(),
207: 			)
208: 		}
209: 	}
210: 
211: 	if err := ensureOwnershipAltName(ctx, e); err != nil {
212: 		return err
213: 	}
214: 
215: 	if err := moveLink(ctx, src, e.GetIfaceName(), dst); err != nil {
216: 		return err
217: 	}
218: 
219: 	if err := src.ReleaseEndpoint(e); err != nil {
220: 		return err
221: 	}
222: 	e.SetNode(dst)
223: 	if err := dst.AdoptEndpoint(e); err != nil {
224: 		e.SetNode(src)
225: 		_ = src.AdoptEndpoint(e)
226: 		return fmt.Errorf(
227: 			"endpoint %q moved but destination ownership update failed: %w",
228: 			e.GetIfaceName(),
229: 			err,
230: 		)
231: 	}
232: 
233: 	return nil
234: }

250: 		if err != nil {

252: 		}
253: 
254: 		return addOwnershipAltName(link, e)
255: 	})

258: // HasSameNodeAndInterface returns true if the given endpoint has the same node and interface name
259: // as the `ept` endpoint.
260: func (e *EndpointGeneric) HasSameNodeAndInterface(ept Endpoint) bool {
261: 	return e.Node == ept.GetNode() && e.IfaceName == ept.GetIfaceName()
262: }

268: 	}

270: }

272: // CheckEndpointUniqueness checks that the given endpoint appears only once for the node
273: // it is assigned to.
274: func CheckEndpointUniqueness(e Endpoint) error {
275: 	for _, ept := range e.GetNode().GetEndpoints() {
276: 		if e == ept {
277: 			// since node contains all endpoints including the one we are checking
278: 			// we skip it
279: 			continue
280: 		}
281: 		// if `e` has the same node and interface name as `ept` then we have a duplicate
282: 		if e.HasSameNodeAndInterface(ept) {
283: 			return fmt.Errorf("duplicate endpoint %s", e)
284: 		}
285: 	}
286: 
287: 	return nil
288: }

293: 	err := CheckEndpointDoesNotExistYet(ctx, e)

296: 	}

300: // CheckEndpointDoesNotExistYet verifies that the interface referenced in the
301: // provided endpoint does not yet exist in the referenced node.
302: func CheckEndpointDoesNotExistYet(ctx context.Context, e Endpoint) error {
303: 	return e.GetNode().ExecFunction(ctx, func(_ ns.NetNS) error {
304: 		// we expect a netlink.LinkNotFoundError when querying for
305: 		// the interface with the given endpoints name
306: 		var err error
307: 		_, err = netlink.LinkByName(e.GetIfaceName())
308: 
309: 		if _, notfound := err.(netlink.LinkNotFoundError); notfound {
310: 			return nil
311: 		}
312: 
313: 		return fmt.Errorf(
314: 			"interface %s is defined via topology but already exists: %v",
315: 			e.String(),
316: 			err,
317: 		)
318: 	})
319: }

322: 	return src.ExecFunction(ctx, func(_ ns.NetNS) error {
323: 		link, err := netlink.LinkByName(ifaceName)
324: 		if err != nil {
325: 			return err
326: 		}
327: 
328: 		if err := netlink.LinkSetDown(link); err != nil {
329: 			return err
330: 		}
331: 
332: 		return dst.AddLinkToContainer(ctx, link, func(_ ns.NetNS) error {
333: 			return nil
334: 		})
335: 	})
336: }

Reasoning
Now key observations on veth-stitch + netem:

1. In `LinkVEthRaw.Resolve`, netem on "host"/"mgmt-net" endpoints is rejected, but for a brief veth converted to veth-stitch (`NewVEthStitchedRawFromVEth`), the endpoints are the same `[]*EndpointRaw` with Netem set. `LinkVEthStitchedRaw.Resolve` → `buildVEthStitchSegment` → `nodeEpRaw.Resolve(params, owner)` → sets `genericEndpoint.Netem = netem` for the node endpoint (veth type). So the node endpoint of each segment has Netem set. Then `applyLinkImpairments` iterates `linksEndpoints(c.Links)` — for LinkVEthStitched, `GetEndpoints()` returns `[segA.Endpoints[0], segB.Endpoints[0]]` — the node endpoints — with Netem set → impairments applied to node interfaces. And the far ends (`epA`, `epB`) are host endpoints without netem. So impairments on veth-stitch node endpoints work fine — traffic between the two nodes passes through both segments; netem qdisc on node interface applies to egress on that interface. But traffic flowing A→B passes egress at A's node iface (impairment 1) and egress at B's node iface (impairment 2, if B also has netem) — so netem applied twice for unidirectional flow? Actually for A→B direction: packet egresses A's interface (qdisc at A applies), enters root-ns stitch, exits at B's node interface... wait no — the far end at B is a host endpoint in root ns; the packet arrives at B's segment's root-ns far end, then goes into the veth pair and egresses at B's node interface? No — veth pairs: traffic from root-ns end enters B node's interface as ingress, not egress. netem qdisc applies to egress (ingress would need ifb). So for the stitched link, a packet A→B: egress at A node iface (netem A applies once), then egress at... the stitch mirred redirect: root-ns far end A's egress is redirected to far end B — that egress at far-end A interface in root ns has no qdisc. Then enters B node iface as ingress — no netem. So netem applied once per direction at the source node's interface. And with netem on both endpoints, A→B traffic gets delayed by A's netem (egress), and B→A traffic delayed by B's. Reasonable.

But is veth-stitch netem intended/documented? Docs say "netem is only supported on veth links". Extended veth-stitch links (topology type `veth-stitch`) with netem declared: `LinkVEthStitchedRaw` parsed directly from topology. Does its Resolve reject netem? 9: // LinkBriefRaw is the representation of any supported link in a brief format as defined in the
10: // topology file.
11: type LinkBriefRaw struct {

13: 	Netem            []*NetemRaw `yaml:"netem,omitempty"`
14: 	LinkCommonParams `         yaml:",inline,omitempty"`

16: 
17: // ToTypeSpecificRawLink resolves the brief link into a concrete RawLink implementation.
18: // LinkBrief is only used to have a short version of a link definition in the topology file,
19: // with ToRawLink we convert it into one of the supported link types.
20: func (l *LinkBriefRaw) ToTypeSpecificRawLink() (RawLink, error) {
21: 	// check two endpoints defined
22: 	if len(l.Endpoints) != 2 {
23: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
24: 			"endpoint definition should consist of exactly 2 entries. %d provided",
25: 			len(l.Endpoints),
26: 		)
27: 	}
28: 	for x, v := range l.Endpoints {
29: 		parts := strings.SplitN(v, ":", 2)
30: 		node := parts[0]
31: 
32: 		lt, err := parseLinkType(node)
33: 		if err != nil {
34: 			continue
35: 		}
36: 
37: 		specialLinkTypes := []LinkType{LinkTypeMacVLan, LinkTypeMgmtNet, LinkTypeHost}
38: 		if len(l.Netem) > 0 && slices.Contains(specialLinkTypes, lt) {
39: 			return nil, fmt.Errorf("netem is only supported on veth links, not on %s links", lt)
40: 		}
41: 
42: 		switch lt {
43: 		case LinkTypeMacVLan:
44: 			return macVlanLinkFromBrief(l, x)
45: 		case LinkTypeMgmtNet:
46: 			return mgmtNetLinkFromBrief(l, x)
47: 		case LinkTypeHost:
48: 			return hostLinkFromBrief(l, x)
49: 		}
50: 	}
51: 
52: 	return linkVEthRawFromLinkBriefRaw(l)
53: }
54: 
55: func (*LinkBriefRaw) GetType() LinkType {
56: 	return LinkTypeBrief
57: }
58:

60: 	return nil, fmt.Errorf(
61: 		"resolve unimplemented on LinkBriefRaw. Use <LinkBriefRaw>.ToTypeSpecificRawLink() and call resolve on the result",
62: 	)
63: }

1: package links
2: 
3: import (
4: 	"context"
5: 
6: 	"github.com/charmbracelet/log"
7: 	clabconstants "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/constants"
8: 	"github.com/vishvananda/netlink"
9: )
10: 
11: // LinkDummyRaw is the raw (string) representation of a dummy link as defined in the topology file.
12: type LinkDummyRaw struct {
13: 	LinkCommonParams `yaml:",inline"`
14: 	Endpoint         *EndpointRaw `yaml:"endpoint"`
15: }
16: 
17: func (*LinkDummyRaw) GetType() LinkType {
18: 	return LinkTypeDummy
19: }
20: 
21: // Resolve resolves the raw veth link definition into a Link interface that is implemented
22: // by a concrete LinkDummyRaw struct.
23: // Resolving a dummy links endpoints.
24: func (r *LinkDummyRaw) Resolve(params *ResolveParams) (Link, error) {
25: 	if err := checkNetemOnVeth(LinkTypeDummy, r.Endpoint); err != nil {
26: 		return nil, err
27: 	}
28: 
29: 	// filtered true means the link is in the filter provided by a user
30: 	// aka it should be resolved/created/deployed
31: 	filtered := isInFilter(params, []*EndpointRaw{r.Endpoint})
32: 	if !filtered {
33: 		return nil, nil
34: 	}
35: 
36: 	// create LinkDummyRaw struct
37: 	l := NewLinkDummy()
38: 	l.LinkCommonParams = r.LinkCommonParams
39: 
40: 	// Normalize link vars to ensure JSON serialization compatibility
41: 	l.Vars = normalizeVars(l.Vars)
42: 
43: 	// resolve raw endpoints (epr) to endpoints (ep)
44: 	ep, err := r.Endpoint.Resolve(params, l)
45: 	if err != nil {
46: 		return nil, err
47: 	}
48: 	// add endpoint to the link endpoints
49: 	l.Endpoints = append(l.Endpoints, ep)
50: 
51: 	// set default link mtu if MTU is unset
52: 	if l.MTU == 0 {
53: 		l.MTU = clabconstants.DefaultLinkMTU
54: 	}
55: 
56: 	return l, nil
57: }
58: 
59: type LinkDummy struct {
60: 	LinkCommonParams
61: 	Endpoints []Endpoint
62: }
63: 
64: func NewLinkDummy() *LinkDummy {
65: 	return &LinkDummy{}
66: }
67: 
68: func (*LinkDummy) GetType() LinkType {
69: 	return LinkTypeDummy
70: }
71: 
72: // Deploy deploys the dummy link.
73: func (l *LinkDummy) Deploy(ctx context.Context, ep Endpoint) error {
74: 	log.Debugf("Creating Endpoint: %s ( --> dummy )", ep)
75: 
76: 	// build the netlink.Dummy struct for the link provisioning
77: 	link := &netlink.Dummy{
78: 		LinkAttrs: netlink.LinkAttrs{
79: 			Name: ep.GetRandIfaceName(),
80: 			MTU:  l.MTU,
81: 			// Mac address is set later on
82: 		},
83: 	}
84: 
85: 	// add the link
86: 	err := netlink.LinkAdd(link)
87: 	if err != nil {
88: 		return err
89: 	}
90: 
91: 	// the link needs to be moved to the relevant network namespace
92: 	// and enabled (up). This is done via linkSetupFunc.
93: 	// based on the endpoint type the link setup function is different.
94: 	// linkSetupFunc is executed in a netns of a node.
95: 	// if the node is a regular namespace node
96: 	// add link to node, rename, set mac and Up
97: 	err = ep.GetNode().AddLinkToContainer(ctx, link,
98: 		SetNameMACAndUpInterface(link, ep))
99: 	if err != nil {
100: 		return err
101: 	}
102: 
103: 	l.DeploymentState = LinkDeploymentStateHalfDeployed
104: 
105: 	return nil
106: }
107: 
108: func (*LinkDummy) PostDeploy(context.Context) error {
109: 	return nil
110: }
111: 
112: func (l *LinkDummy) Remove(ctx context.Context) error {
113: 	if l.DeploymentState == LinkDeploymentStateRemoved {
114: 		return nil
115: 	}
116: 	for _, ep := range l.GetEndpoints() {
117: 		err := ep.Remove(ctx)
118: 		if err != nil {
119: 			log.Debug(err)
120: 		}
121: 	}
122: 	l.DeploymentState = LinkDeploymentStateRemoved
123: 	return nil
124: }
125: 
126: func (l *LinkDummy) GetEndpoints() []Endpoint {
127: 	return l.Endpoints
128: }
129: 
130: func (l *LinkDummy) GetRuntimeEndpoints() []Endpoint {
131: 	return l.GetEndpoints()
132: }

        "text": "package links\n\nimport (\n\t\"context\"\n\n\t\"github.com/charmbracelet/log\"\n\tclabconstants \"github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/constants\"\n\t\"github.com/vishvananda/netlink\"\n)\n\n// LinkDummyRaw is the raw (string) representation of a dummy link as defined in the topology file.\ntype LinkDummyRaw struct {\n\tLinkCommonParams `yaml:\",inline\"`\n\tEndpoint         *EndpointRaw `yaml:\"endpoint\"`\n}\n\nfunc (*LinkDummyRaw) GetType() LinkType {\n\treturn LinkTypeDummy\n}\n\n// Resolve resolves the raw veth link definition into a Link interface that is implemented\n// by a concrete LinkDummyRaw struct.\n// Resolving a dummy links endpoints.\nfunc (r *LinkDummyRaw) Resolve(params *ResolveParams) (Link, error) {\n\tif err := checkNetemOnVeth(LinkTypeDummy, r.Endpoint); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\n\t// filtered true means the link is in the filter provided by a user\n\t// aka it should be resolved/created/deployed\n\tfiltered := isInFilter(params, []*EndpointRaw{r.Endpoint})\n\tif !filtered {\n\t\treturn nil, nil\n\t}\n\n\t// create LinkDummyRaw struct\n\tl := NewLinkDummy()\n\tl.LinkCommonParams = r.LinkCommonParams\n\n\t// Normalize link vars to ensure JSON serialization compatibility\n\tl.Vars = normalizeVars(l.Vars)\n\n\t// resolve raw endpoints (epr) to endpoints (ep)\n\tep, err := r.Endpoint.Resolve(params, l)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\t// add endpoint to the link endpoints\n\tl.Endpoints = append(l.Endpoints, ep)\n\n\t// set default link mtu if MTU is unset\n\tif l.MTU == 0 {\n\t\tl.MTU = clabconstants.DefaultLinkMTU\n\t}\n\n\treturn l, nil\n}\n\ntype LinkDummy struct {\n\tLinkCommonParams\n\tEndpoints []Endpoint\n}\n\nfunc NewLinkDummy() *LinkDummy {\n\treturn &LinkDummy{}\n}\n\nfunc (*LinkDummy) GetType() LinkType {\n\treturn LinkTypeDummy\n}\n\n// Deploy deploys the dummy link.\nfunc (l *LinkDummy) Deploy(ctx context.Context, ep Endpoint) error {\n\tlog.Debugf(\"Creating Endpoint: %s ( --> dummy )\", ep)\n\n\t// build the netlink.Dummy struct for the link provisioning\n\tlink := &netlink.Dummy{\n\t\tLinkAttrs: netlink.LinkAttrs{\n\t\t\tName: ep.GetRandIfaceName(),\n\t\t\tMTU:  l.MTU,\n\t\t\t// Mac address is set later on\n\t\t},\n\t}\n\n\t// add the link\n\terr := netlink.LinkAdd(link)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\t// the link needs to be moved to the relevant network namespace\n\t// and enabled (up). This is done via linkSetupFunc.\n\t// based on the endpoint type the link setup function is different.\n\t// linkSetupFunc is executed in a netns of a node.\n\t// if the node is a regular namespace node\n\t// add link to node, rename, set mac and Up\n\terr = ep.GetNode().AddLinkToContainer(ctx, link,\n\t\tSetNameMACAndUpInterface(link, ep))\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\n\tl.DeploymentState = LinkDeploymentStateHalfDeployed\n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (*LinkDummy) PostDeploy(context.Context) error {\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (l *LinkDummy) Remove(ctx context.Context) error {\n\tif l.DeploymentState == LinkDeploymentStateRemoved {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\tfor _, ep := range l.GetEndpoints() {\n\t\terr := ep.Remove(ctx)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\tlog.Debug(err)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tl.DeploymentState = LinkDeploymentStateRemoved\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (l *LinkDummy) GetEndpoints() []Endpoint {\n\treturn l.Endpoints\n}\n\nfunc (l *LinkDummy) GetRuntimeEndpoints() []Endpoint {\n\treturn l.GetEndpoints()\n}",
